title: This College Football Promotion Is Wild - NewsBreak
text:
By Ace Sauerwein ,
3 hours ago
What do you know about the Akron Zips? I’m willing to bet you don’t have a lot of knowledge about the MAC team, other than their men’s basketball team making the NCAA Tournament last season.
They didn’t stay in the tournament very long, as they got WAXED by Texas Tech in the first round.
Regardless, you’re going to know about Akron for their online stunt to drive football season ticket owner numbers up.
Akron Will Let You Call Plays for One Drive The Zips announced that if you sign up for Zips season tickets, you’ll have a chance to call plays during Akron’s opening drive of the 2026 season.
Seriously.
READ MORE: Grizzly Soccer Headlines International Exhibition Match In The Flathead
Can you imagine Bobby Kennedy in his first game giving the headset over to some eGriz fan? “Give ’em hell, @GrizFan210.”
Or better yet, could you imagine former Grizzly Head Coach Bobby Hauck doing that? If our marketing department came to him and told him they were letting a fan calling the drive’s first plays, he might have an aneurysm on the spot.
READ MORE: Every Montana Hometown Represented By The 2026 Grizzlies Football Roster
What would you call on the first drive? A couple of flea-flickers on back-to-back plays to begin the season? Trot out the field goal unit for a fake field goal at your own 22-yardline?
There has to be a catch to it, but I’m intrigued to see Akron’s opening drive against Robert Morris.
